svg.title: How I build
svg.desc: Numbers come from code In AI Co-Founder and Buff Your Money the model may propose, but tested code computes every figure a user sees. Every quote is checked Spead AI Pro tells the reviewer whether each citation appears in full, in part or not at all in the contract. People approve side effects Agents on Kasir POS or on company systems can draft; a person approves anything that changes data. Isolation by default One container per AgentBuff user, tenant limits in the data layer, row level security on the WIKA platforms. It runs where the data lives Spead AI deploys to private cloud or on premise for government bodies, BUMN and regulated industries.
